programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Bill says he believes he is a narcissist after pushing away almost all of his loved ones, including his brother Tom and daughter Bridget, who both stopped speaking to him. After a tense reunion with Tom, Bill gets emotional when Dr. Phil reunites him with Bridget. After violent fights, cruel words, and selfish behavior, will Bill start taking accountability and change?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: There comes a point when every child must grow up and face life on their own. For today’s guests, that time has come and gone and they want stay with Mom and Dad! You’ll meet Ryan, whose father says he’s borrowed over $10,000, and has trouble standing on his own two feet. And watch as Dr. Phil gives another young adult the tools she needs to create a life of her own. Find out what needs to happen before your offspring fly the coop.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A mom wants to be a better parent. A wife can’t get her husband off the couch. A husband that just can’t seem to please his finicky wife. What do all these people have in common? Dr. Phil gives them what they need to put their lives back on track in the “How To…” episode. No matter what the issue or situation, we all share problems that keep us from leader a happier, healthier life. Tune in and find yourself in our courageous guests as they face their own battles with the help of Dr. Phil McGraw. Appointment television you won’t want to miss.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The 1957 kidnapping and murder of Maria Ridulph went cold for 55 years, until Jack McCullough, once known as John Tessier, was arrested and eventually convicted -- despite maintaining his innocence. Dr. Phil speaks to family members on both sides. Could McCullough have been wrongfully convicted?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Seven years ago, Brandon was an out-of-control drug addict, until his LIVE intervention on the Dr. Phil stage led him down the path to sobriety. Now clean for five years, Brandon and his mother, Debbie, pay it forward by helping other families confront their loved ones about their destructive addictions. A family desperate to save their three drug-addicted brothers: Sean, 28, Jordan, 24, and Logan, 23, reaches out to Brandon and Debbie for help. It’s an unpredictable event fraught with issues. Don’t miss this dramatic triple intervention!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: YouTube sensation “Homeless Joe,” 26, survives on the mean streets of Manhattan by panhandling during the day and picking up women at night. Joe admits he could get a place of his own if he stopped drinking but says being homeless without alcohol is unbearable. Is this “cardboard Casanova” interested in turning his life around?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Nobody likes a know-it-all, but what if you’re married to one? Kenton says his bags are packed, because he can’t take his wife’s criticism anymore. One more blow up and he’s ready to walk! Next—Jay says his wife Kristin is uneducated, absent-minded, and an easy target. She’s tired of being the butt of his jokes and wants it to end. And, Jeremy says his new wife can’t follow “the rules!” Is their 4-month-old marriage on the brink of collapse?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Their job is to protect you. They won't let you walk down the street alone. They call your house five times a day, screen your calls, monitor your every move. No, it's not the government or the F.B.I., it's mothers! Is there such a thing as a mom having too much love for her child? Dr. Phil puts Mom to the test!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Pat and his wife, Sarah, claim they’re scared for their family’s safety. Pat claims his father, John, is delusional, violent, paranoid and so dangerous, that Pat sleeps on the couch in his living room to protect his wife and two children in the event that John comes to the house at night to harm them. Pat and Sarah say John’s delusions have gotten so bad they’ve had to cut ties with him. John, on the other hand, completely denies the allegations. He says his daughter-in-law is to blame for stealing his son, filling his head with evil and turning Pat against him. Can Dr. Phil bridge the gap between father and son and bring this whole family back together again?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: After 12 years of marriage, Ed revealed to Kandi that he'd been having an affair and his mistress is now pregnant. Dr. Phil continues his in-depth look at the anatomy of an affair.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Stay-at-home mom Jessica claims her soon-to-be ex-husband of 23 years, Mike, is a narcissist who controls everything in her and their teenage daughters’ lives, especially the finances. Sixteen-year-old Chloe and 18-year-old Zoey say the worst thing he did was to shatter their dreams of becoming professional dancers in New York City. But Mike claims Jessica is putting the girls in the middle of their fight and brainwashing them to hate him. Dr. Phil tells Mike and Jessica what every couple needs to do with children when their marriage falls apart.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The conversation continues with a woman who claims she is "Mother God."

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil looks into the nature of passive aggressive and pessimistic behaviors. One wife needs Dr. Phil’s help dealing with her passive aggressive husband. He never tells her what he’s thinking and often leaves to avoid confrontation. She says this punishment is hurtful and has their marriage in serious jeopardy. Plus, meet a college student whose negativity is alienating her from friends and potential boyfriends. Tune in for Dr. Phil’s cure for this bad case of bad attitude.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his conversation with Christina, who emailed him desperate for help for her daughter, Tara, who she says can be an angry monster. Christina left the home when Tara was 13 years old, but now, she says she's worried that her daughter is in a toxic situation with the ex-husband she calls narcissistic and his 22-year-old new wife who is 20 weeks pregnant. Today, meet the new wife and find out if Dr. Phil can help this chaotic triangle.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Is compulsive spending ruining your life? According to a recent Gallup poll, the average American owes $29,000 in credit card debt, and last year, 1.6 million U.S. households filed for bankruptcy. Dr. Phil has advice for avoiding credit card catastrophes this holiday season.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Nearly 20 years after graduation, Dr. Phil's guests say they can't shake their high school image and are striving to overcome their deeply rooted insecurities. Plus, Dr. Phil reveals the common characteristics of victims of bullies.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Heather and Chris say their six-year marriage is on the brink of divorce because of their constant heated arguments, which they admit happen almost daily, in front of their two young children. Heather, a stay-at-home mom, says Chris is so controlling that he constantly accuses her of cheating on him, checks her phone records to see whom she’s calling and won’t let her handle their finances. Chris says Heather is only with him for the money and has gotten violent with him during their disagreements -- some of which have been caught on tape. He says she has kicked him in the privates, slapped him in the face and thrown a tape measure at his head -- all in front of the kids. What’s driving the couple’s anger? Plus, Chris recently filed for divorce -- will he change his mind and agree to work on their marriage? Then, Kerry says she and her husband, Sam, engage in explosive fighting at least four times a week, and she fears someone will get seriously hurt. Can this couple learn to fight fairly? This program contains strong language. Viewer discretion advised.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Chandra and her siblings, Charity, Perry and Preston, say their mother, Pamela’s, hoarding is so out of control that nearly every inch of her 9,000-square-foot home is filled with “junk.” The siblings say that growing up, Pamela would pick through their garbage to save items, which forced them to sneak trash out of the house. They say as they got older, her hoarding became progressively worse, prompting them to stage an intervention in 2012, which escalated to the point of police being called. Pamela says she feels her family unfairly “ganged up” on her and insists she’s not a hoarder -- so, how does she explain the mess? Plus, Pamela’s husband, Richard, moved out of the house two years ago -- he says because of the hoarding, but she says otherwise. Hear why Pamela claims Richard is equally to blame for the family’s problems. Can Dr. Phil help Pamela get rid of her clutter -- and help this family get back on track?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Every day, many teen girls fear for their lives because of obsessive, controlling and abusive boyfriends, and it’s another reason why Dr. Phil is so passionate about his campaign to End the Silence on Domestic Violence. Seventeen-year-old Samantha sent an urgent plea for help to Dr. Phil. She says her ex-boyfriend, Aaron, called her nonstop for weeks and sent her threatening text messages after she broke up with him. After Samantha changed her number, he began calling her mother repeatedly. Samantha says he showed up unannounced at her house and pounded on the door for 45 minutes while she cowered in a locked closet. She says she’s afraid Aaron could even kill her. Dr. Phil sits down with the two teens to help Samantha get her message to Aaron loud and clear. And, Tiffany, 20, has a cautionary tale of survival every teen needs to hear. It could save her life!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What do you do when life’s problems seem so overwhelming that it feels like there’s no way out? Kenny, who was one of the first responders to the 9/11 tragedy, says he still struggles with post-traumatic stress disorder and other health challenges. His wife, Cyndi, and daughter, Gina, say he just sits on the couch and obsesses about that fateful day, and they feel he needs to get over it. Can Kenny get his life and his health back? Then, Steve and Jacki have been married for four years, and Steve says he’s at a crossroads in his relationship. He says his wife puts him last and moved her elderly parents into their home while he was on the road. Jacki says she can’t get over her husband’s insensitivity to her dying mother, and isn’t sure if their relationship can be saved. Is it time for Steve to say enough is enough and move on?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The case of Thomas Cogdell, who confessed to his sister's muder at age 12, is examined.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When it comes to families, conflict is nearly inevitable, but when you add the stress of a mental illness, it can divide even the closest knit household. Coni’s 18-year-old daughter, Katherine, was diagnosed with bipolar disorder at 12. Since then, her daughter’s behavior has been violent and erratic, and Coni says the chaos is tearing their family apart. Coni’s husband has threatened divorce, her oldest son has moved out, and her youngest daughter says her childhood was awful because of her older sister. The family thinks Katherine should be moved to a facility that can better serve her, but Coni says that is not an option. Learn what Dr. Phil says this family is doing wrong and how they can create a happy, peaceful household.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Does your child lie, steal, swear, or test you daily? Karen and Matt's son is only 4 years old, but he’s already cursing! Patty and Eric's 8-year-old son has been stealing since kindergarten. Now, they’re worried this could lead to a life of crime. Plus, a boy whose nickname is Dracula because he’s always biting somebody! And, what if you kept finding your 4-year-old in his birthday suit with the little girl next door? Beverly and Shea say they can't figure out why their kids like to get naked and play.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Cindy and Jim say they are fed up with their 35-year-old son, Brandon. They say he’s a moocher who refuses to get job, wears superhero costumes on a daily basis, and has caused $15,000 in damages to their property. Brandon says his parents don’t understand how his mind works. He admits to wearing superhero costumes and going on nightly “Batman” vigilante missions. Brandon says he also created a rapper persona named “Ceeza Caprice” and considers himself a “God MC” who can rap to any beat. Brandon’s sister, Harmony, says she blames her parents for Brandon’s behavior. She says they enable Brandon. She claims Brandon is a manipulator who sees it as a challenge to live off others.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil rings in 2005 with a “New Year’s Resolutions Week” to help you make changes that really matter! Today he helps tackle the number one issue couples fight about – Money! Eris and Vivian spend so much on designer clothes, they cut out costs that really matter - like groceries! They’ve filed for bankruptcy once, have a home in foreclosure, are more than $28,000 in debt…and they still can’t stop shopping! Thai and CJ live paycheck-to-paycheck and even started to sell their kids' old clothes on eBay just to make ends meet. Dr. Phil has some action plans that can help them and you reach your goals.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In this powerful program, Dr. Phil exposes the frightening yet underreported problem of mothers on the verge on committing child abuse. We meet ordinary women who live in fear that they’re going to hurt their children in a fit of uncontrollable rage. Chrystel says she feels rage and snaps and then it gets to the point where there's no return. Jessica says her fits of rage become so intense, she's scared that she will hurt her son. Answering their desperate pleas for help, Dr. Phil explains how to identify cues leading up to this precarious state, and tells moms what to do when they start to lose control.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Christina and Jim are divorced, and their 21-year-old daughter, Tara, is living with her dad and his new wife who just happens to be the same age as Tara. Christina claims Jim was a horrible husband and a narcissist and she was forced to walk away from the family when Tara was just 13. Since then, she says Jim has let Tara get away with anything and now even allows her to work as a webcam model in order to help pay the bills! She says he is turning their daughter into a raging, angry monster with low self-esteem.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In a Dr. Phil exclusive, a 17-year-old football star accused of rape -- and the alleged victim -- speak out about how one alcohol-fueled night changed their lives in an instant. Matt says he and three friends were drinking at a party nearly nine months ago when the four boys had sex with a 16-year-old classmate. He claims she initiated the encounter and that the sex was consensual. Matt and the three boys are charged with second-degree rape, and Matt says his dreams of getting a college scholarship have been put on hold. How does he describe the events of that night? And, what, if anything, does he say he’d do differently? Then, hear from the alleged victim, who is speaking out for the first time. What does she recall happening that night? And, how has the ordeal impacted her life? Plus, Matt’s parents, Dianne and Mark, insist their son is innocent and say they believe the alleged victim is out for attention. Dr. Phil has a powerful message for the couple.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Mike and Vicki say their 37-year-old son, Ryan, was once making millions running a successful real estate company, but for the past three months, he has been living in their garage, on their dime, along with his 24-year-old girlfriend, Rachel. The parents claim Ryan is a “freeloader” who sleeps all day, acts entitled, picks fights and even leaves them to care for his 5-year-old son. Ryan admits things are chaotic in his life but insists it’s not all his fault. Why does he say his parents are partly to blame for his business failing? Dr. Phil has some tough questions for Ryan about his behavior -- does he take any accountability? And, hear from Rachel -- is she happy with their living situation? Plus, Ryan isn’t the only one staying with mom and dad -- you won’t believe how many mouths Mike and Vicki say they are feeding! How can the parents stop the bleeding and take back control of their lives? And, is Ryan ready to step up to the plate and work toward living on his own?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The mother/daughter relationship can take many forms: best friends, parent-child, and in the case of today’s guests, adversaries. You’ll meet one mom who’s driving her daughter crazy with constant phone calls and unexpected visits. Are her actions creating the separation she fears most? Find out how another mom’s money mismanagement has her daughter feeling both financially and emotionally at risk. Moms, daughters and trust - on the next Dr. Phil.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In part 1 of two episodes, Dr. Phil meets Cheryl, her ex-husband, Dave, and their youngest daughter, Stephanie, who say oldest daughter Cassie has been a drug addict and an alcoholic for years and needs an intervention. One source of contention is the allegation that Dave not only did drugs with Cassie but also received money from her that she admittedly earned through prostitution. Dave counters that, despite using drugs with Cassie twice, he did not encourage Cassie to be a prostitute and he gave back the money Cassie earned through prostitution. Dave contends that he is actually fighting for Cassie’s sobriety and has helped save her life by giving her a home to live in. Things take an uncertain turn when Cassie decides to leave the studio one hour before the taping and run down Melrose Avenue to a liquor store with staffers chasing her. Will Cassie ever make it to stage to talk to Dr. Phil?

programme.title: BarryTiger

Con una variedad de personajes coloridos y temas ricos y diversos, la serie muestra los momentos alegres de la vida de la familia BarryTiger. La producción musical de alta calidad, con melodías excepcionales, arreglos sobresalientes y actuaciones destacadas, añade una capa extra de diversión a las escenas animadas y dinámicas. ¡Prepárate para cantar, bailar y explorar junto a Barry y sus amigos en cada emocionante episodio!

programme.title: Domi Kids
programme.desc: "Domi Kids es una serie musical animada en 3D que da vida a las alegres y cálidas aventuras diarias de la familia Domi, compuesta por cinco integrantes. Con música animada y divertida, y actuaciones de múltiples personajes, el programa ofrece una gran variedad de temas, historias atractivas y escenas diversas. Un equipo profesional de producción musical asegura melodías de primera calidad, arreglos excepcionales y actuaciones vocales destacadas, brindando un festín audiovisual encantador para los niños. El contenido es positivo, entretenido y está diseñado para ayudar a los niños a aprender y explorar el mundo de una manera apropiada para su edad. Además, apoya a los padres en su camino hacia una crianza fácil y placentera, mientras acompaña a los niños en su crecimiento y desarrollo."

programme.title: Papelitos
programme.desc: La serie animada “papelitos” cuenta de una manera divertida a los más pequeñitos sobre las simpáticas aventuras de unos animales de papel: Un alce llamado Aristóteles y un pájaro carpintero llamado Tuc-Tuc en el país de papel donde todo por completo está hecho de papel. Divertidas aventuras se acompañan con interesantes clases de manualidades donde los espectadores aprenderán como con papel y cartón crear a todos los personajes de la serie utilizando tijeras y pegamento. El proyecto tiene apoyo de la página web donde están presentados todos los moldes y consejos para crear el mundo de papel. De esta manera el espectador participa en el juego que supone la creación y el desarrollo de muchas habilidades prácticas que distraen a los chicos del encierro permanente de la computadora. El proyecto “Papelitos” es una divertida y didáctica alternativa en lugar de pasar tiempo con la computadora. Toda la acción en el dibujo animado es narrada por una voz en off y repleta de ingeniosos chistes. Cada capítulo dura 5 minutos (la versión sin clase – 4 minutos). La técnica de animación – gráficos 3D que imitan al papel.

Si entre los seres humanos una simple discusión en general, va a terminar con sólo un par de insultos, en el caso de los Glumpers puede terminar, en el mejor de los casos, en una explosión atómica.

programme.title: Alex y el Huerto

Alex espera con impaciencia para ver como la fruta o vegetal va a crecer. Luego, con destellos de magia, surge de una planta del suelo, y ahí está ... ... un naranjo! Va con una cesta y coge la fruta que van a comer para el almuerzo. Abuela y Alex se sientan a la mesa y comen la fruta o beben su jugo. En Al final, podemos ver y escuchar la explicación de las propiedades básicas de la fruta que acaban de comer.

programme.title: Papelitos
programme.desc: La serie animada “papelitos” cuenta de una manera divertida a los más pequeñitos sobre las simpáticas aventuras de unos animales de papel: Un alce llamado Aristóteles y un pájaro carpintero llamado Tuc-Tuc en el país de papel donde todo por completo está hecho de papel. Divertidas aventuras se acompañan con interesantes clases de manualidades donde los espectadores aprenderán como con papel y cartón crear a todos los personajes de la serie utilizando tijeras y pegamento. El proyecto tiene apoyo de la página web donde están presentados todos los moldes y consejos para crear el mundo de papel. De esta manera el espectador participa en el juego que supone la creación y el desarrollo de muchas habilidades prácticas que distraen a los chicos del encierro permanente de la computadora. El proyecto “Papelitos” es una divertida y didáctica alternativa en lugar de pasar tiempo con la computadora. Toda la acción en el dibujo animado es narrada por una voz en off y repleta de ingeniosos chistes. Cada capítulo dura 5 minutos (la versión sin clase – 4 minutos). La técnica de animación – gráficos 3D que imitan al papel.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: In the quarter finals, Belgian Moroccan Anis Bouzid (48-4, 37 KO) takes on kickboxing legend Errol Zimmerman (112-20-1, 45 KO), Serbian sensation Milos Cvjeticanin (17-5, 10 KO) meets number one French heavyweight Sofian Laidouni (42-5-1, 20 KO), monstrous Tariq ‘Cookie’ Osaro (29-4-1, 16 KO) clashes with ‘The Soldier’ Nidal Bchiri (20-5-1, 5 KO), and ‘The Black Ghost’ Mory Kromah (35-3-1, 21 KO) collides with outspoken rival Michael ‘Timebomb’ Boapeah (23-5-1, 29 KO). Only one fighter can come out on top and walk away as the new ‘King of Kickboxing’. Elsewhere, the always exciting Bahram Rajabzadeh (72-6, 64 KO) goes up against ‘The Gladiator’ Cristian Ristea (44-27, 13 KO), Hamicha (42-2, 31 KO) puts his undefeated GLORY record on the line against late replacement Brice Kombou (20-6, 5 KO), and featherweights Andre Santos (23-2, 10 KO) and Deniz Demirkapu (15-5, 10 KO) will kick-off the main card.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY featherweight world champion Petch (175-40-3, 27 KO) will rematch KO artist Abraham Vidales (18-4, 14 KO) and Portuguese sensation Miguel Trindade (64-8, 26 KO) will look to avenge his 2023 loss to the always entertaining Berjan Peposhi (32-6, 16 KO). Former GLORY title contender & leading Japanese fighter Kento Haraguchi (28-6-1, 18 KO) will go up against talented newcomer Hiroki Kasahara (39-8, 17 KO) while popular South Korean veteran Sung-hyun Lee (71-13-2, 17 KO) takes on top young prospect Yura Kono (17-1, 9 KO). In addition, the seven-fight card will be headlined by Shiro Matsumoto (55-17-4, 19 KO) defending his RISE bantamweight title against Koki Osaki (38-6-1, 21 KO). In the co-main event, budding superstar Ryujin Nasukawa (17-2, 8 KO) and heavy-hitter Kaito Hasegawa (17-2, 13 KO) battle for the vacant RISE super flyweight championship.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: The welterweight superfight between former GLORY world champion Endy Semeleer (36-2, 18 KO) and current GLORY lightweight world champion Tyjani Beztati (26-4, 9 KO) will take center stage in the main event of the evening. After dominating the lightweight division, Beztati moves up to welterweight for the very first time in his GLORY career. GLORY featherweight world champion Petch (169-40-3, 27 KO) and RISE national champion Kento Haraguchi (25-3-1, 14 KO) made their trilogy fight official for the co-main event. Two former middleweight title challengers collide as the number one ranked Michael Boapeah (17-4-1, 7 KO) takes on the number three ranked Ulric Bokeme (32-5, 17 KO), both fighters chasing a rematch at champion Donovan Wisse. Top Dutch star Tayfun Özcan (86-10-3, 28 KO) will make his highly anticipated GLORY debut against French champion Majid Amarouche (25-2-1, 10 KO).

Former GLORY title contender & leading Japanese fighter Kento Haraguchi (28-6-1, 18 KO) will go up against talented newcomer Hiroki Kasahara (39-8, 17 KO) while popular South Korean veteran Sung-hyun Lee (71-13-2, 17 KO) takes on top young prospect Yura Kono (17-1, 9 KO). In addition, the seven-fight card will be headlined by Shiro Matsumoto (55-17-4, 19 KO) defending his RISE bantamweight title against Koki Osaki (38-6-1, 21 KO). In the co-main event, budding superstar Ryujin Nasukawa (17-2, 8 KO) and heavy-hitter Kaito Hasegawa (17-2, 13 KO) battle for the vacant RISE super flyweight championship.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: The welterweight superfight between former GLORY world champion Endy Semeleer (36-2, 18 KO) and current GLORY lightweight world champion Tyjani Beztati (26-4, 9 KO) will take center stage in the main event of the evening. After dominating the lightweight division, Beztati moves up to welterweight for the very first time in his GLORY career. GLORY featherweight world champion Petch (169-40-3, 27 KO) and RISE national champion Kento Haraguchi (25-3-1, 14 KO) made their trilogy fight official for the co-main event. Two former middleweight title challengers collide as the number one ranked Michael Boapeah (17-4-1, 7 KO) takes on the number three ranked Ulric Bokeme (32-5, 17 KO), both fighters chasing a rematch at champion Donovan Wisse. Top Dutch star Tayfun Özcan (86-10-3, 28 KO) will make his highly anticipated GLORY debut against French champion Majid Amarouche (25-2-1, 10 KO).

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: The World Pickleball League returns for an explosive Season 2 at the iconic Jio World Garden in BKC, Mumbai. The season opener features a high-stakes rematch of last year's final: the defending champion Bengaluru Jawans, owned by cinematic powerhouse Atlee and Priya Atlee, take on the formidable Pune United, led by owner Riteish Deshmukh. Witness world-class athletes from 18 countries compete in a series of intense Men’s Singles, Women’s Doubles, and Mixed Doubles matches. With the pressure of a "Davis Cup" atmosphere and the precision of tactical "kitchen" play, both teams battle for every point to establish early dominance in India’s premier pickleball league.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: Welcome to Championship Sunday at the NCPA Utah Regional 2025. This Round of 16 Collegiate Team Match pits the 5th-seeded Utah Tech against the 12th-seeded, but formidable, Utah State squad. The action takes place at Club Pickleball USA in Orem, Utah. Both teams are competing for a coveted bid to the National Championship in Saint Louis, Missouri, which features a $30,000 prize pool.

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate Super Regional
programme.desc: Experience a high-stakes "teeter-totter" battle as Utah State and Utah Tech 2 face off in the semifinals of the 2024 DUPR Nevada Super Regional. The atmosphere in Henderson is electric as Utah Tech’s young phenom, 15-year-old Mary Monson, showcases incredible shot sequencing and skill in the opening Women's Doubles match. After an intense start where each side fights for every inch of the court at Lifetime Fitness, the match reaches a fever pitch in the Mixed Doubles rounds. With a trip to the finals on the line, the rivalry culminates in a dramatic Dream Breaker, proving that in collegiate pickleball, no lead is safe until the final point is served.

The atmosphere is electric as Rajasthan’s Lorena Dupnik delivers a "professional performance" in a come-from-behind singles victory against Delhi’s Mehek Kuan, setting a fierce tone for the tie. With veteran Rob Cassidy making his highly anticipated men's doubles debut, every rally becomes a desperate fight for dominance in the season's final league encounter.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)

The match features a Racing pace with a unique sudden-death format that forces players to switch between singles, doubles, and mixed rounds every three points. Watch as these elite competitors demonstrate incredible Skills at the kitchen line, including precision dinks and aggressive "off the bounce" initiates that define modern collegiate play. This high-energy showdown serves as the ultimate prelude to Championship Sunday, proving that the future of pickleball is brighter than ever.

programme.title: The Wager
programme.desc: Set at the scenic Troubadour Golf and Field Club in Nashville, TN, this exhibition match brings a mix of celebrity flair and friendly competition to the pickleball court. Olympian Shawn Johnson and her husband Andrew East take on TV host Jason Kennedy and pro Wes Burrows in a lighthearted yet tightly contested match that goes down to the wire. With Shawn still learning the ropes (and the rules), and Andrew channeling his athletic instincts, the duo puts up an impressive fight against the more experienced Kennedy and Burrows. It’s a fast-paced, fun-filled match full of laughs, learning moments, and great rallies—perfect for fans of lifestyle sports and celebrity matchups.

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate National Championship

The high-intensity matches, including women’s and men’s doubles, push these athletes to their limits as they fight to avoid another heart-pounding "dream breaker" finish. This high-stakes showdown captures the pure spirit of collegiate pickleball, where technical precision and emotional resilience decide who advances to face the defending champions.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's momma escapes from the home for mothers of villains and demands her birthday present! When she endangers Sonic and Tails, and they manage to have her taken back to the home, even Robotnik is glad to see her go.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: A country and western singer released a song about Sonic which is making Dr. Robotnik mad and builds a music destroyer robot.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: An energetic salesman named Wes Weasley sells Robotnik numerous gadgets to help Scratch and Grounder capture Sonic. However, Robotnik later comes to regret it when Weaseley's gadgets keep backfiring.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic and Tails rescue Lucas, Robotnik's first prisoner, and attempt to reunite him with his girlfriend, Lucinda. However, Robotnik is also in love with Lucinda, and pursues Lucas.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: En route to stop a train of explosives from arriving at Robotnik's munition factory, Sonic and Tails must deal with a duo of bears named Big Griz and Big Mike after Scratch and Grounder tell them that Sonic and Tails are the enemies.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik takes Professor Von Schlemmer hostage and uses his growth machine to try and enlarge himself. programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Sonic decides to find Tails a suitable foster home to ensure his safety, Robotnik finds out and creates a robot fox family, who pose as Tails' long-lost parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When overweight, elderly superhero Captain Rescue bungles in his attempts to help Sonic, he grows tired of his incompetence. Robotnik then uses Captain Rescue to successfully imprison Sonic in an impenetrable force field, and Tails and Captain Rescue must save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch suffers a blow to the head and believes that he is his favorite television character, Edgar Eagle. Sonic uses this to his advantage in preventing another of Robotnik's schemes.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: There is a Sonic Appreciation Day happening where Sonic is the guest in a hotel. However, someone steals his power sneakers and now Sonic and Tails have to find the culprit.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Tails adopts a cute and fuzzy pet named Walter who turns out to be a black hole who sucks up everything in Mobius. Realizing that Walter is from another dimension our heroes have to return him and they soon find themselves spinning through interdimensional limbo.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik opens up a resort to make the resident Mobians his slaves, Sonic enlists the help of some robots from an area of Mobius called Scrap Valley.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik creates a robot Sonic suit with the intent of ruining the hedgehog's reputation. He forces a lab rat named Laurence to pilot by threatening his parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Dr. Robotnik creates a genius chip so he would have enough brains to rule Mobius, however a computer hacker got hold of it which then the chip landed inside Grounder causing him to be smart.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

When Tails is finally caught, Sonic speeds back to save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik introduces the Ultra Freeze-O-Matic, announcing his plan to freeze every citizen on Mobius so that he can install Servitude Chips into the frozen citizens and make them unquestionably obedient. Sonic and Tails must foil the scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik invades Labyrinth, an underwater city, and kidnaps Princess Bubbles, a seahorse-dude named Surff seeks Sonic's help. It seems Surff and the Princess are in love, but the royal family deems Surff unworthy. Sonic, Tails and Surff must avoid the undersea traps and Mobius sea monsters while Sonic rescues the Princess and reunites her with Surff -- making it look like Surff did the whole thing.

programme.desc: Robotnik reprograms a machine created by Von Schlemmer capable of turning dreams into reality, unleashing a Nightmare Monster upon Mobius.

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: Mientras el Oso está ocupado remendando los hermosos vestidos de Masha, ella hurga en su armario y encuentra una vieja cámara. Toma una foto y descubre que tiene talento para la fotografía. Luego, decide poner a prueba sus habilidades y organizar una sesión fotográfica para todos los animales del bosque.

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: ¡Alerta! ¡La nevera de Bear está en peligro! Alguien entró en su casa para quedarse de por vida ... ¡pero Oso está listo para defender sus cosas! Busca un heroe, pero lo que encuentra es una nueva historia llena de descubrimientos inesperados que llevará a Masha y a Oso a conclusiones inesperadas.

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: Todos sienten curiosidad por tener más datos sobre sus antepasados: cómo eran, qué hacían... - Érase una vez un Oso que se interesó en cómo podría lucir su Oso progenitor. - Para responder esta pregunta, el Oso debe inventar y construir... ¿adivinen qué? ¡Una verdadera máquina del tiempo! Y, por supuesto, ¡Masha no se perdería ese descubrimiento por nada del mundo!Todos sienten curiosidad por tener más datos sobre sus antepasados: cómo eran, qué hacían... - Érase una vez un Oso que se interesó en cómo podría lucir su Oso progenitor. - Para responder esta pregunta, el Oso debe inventar y construir... ¿adivinen qué? ¡Una verdadera máquina del tiempo! Y, por supuesto, ¡Masha no se perdería ese descubrimiento por nada del mundo!

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: Érase una vez un invierno en que el niño Pingüino visitó al Oso. El Oso trató de entretenerlo y de hacerlo participar de diversas actividades, pero el Pingüino pasa la mayor parte del tiempo jugando con Masha. Aunque lo intenta una y otra vez, el Oso no logra llamar la atención del Pingüino y se pone triste. Masha se da cuenta de esto y se le ocurre una idea para arreglar las cosas.

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: El Oso juega al ajedrez. Masha lo interrumpe para pedirle que la alimente. El Oso le cocina crema de avena, pero a Masha no le gusta. El Oso se va de la casa hecho una furia. Masha decide cocinarse su propia crema de avena. Pero muy pronto, la crema se hincha y se expande. Todos los habitantes del bosque recordarán este día por mucho tiempo...

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: Con la llegada de septiembre, Masha, como todos los niños, quiere ir a la escuela y le pide al Oso que le fabrique una. Abrumado por el entusiasmo, el Oso completa la tarea y al día siguiente Masha se sienta en un escritorio a estrenar. La niña trata de comportarse como una estudiante atenta, pero termina volviendo absolutamente loco al Oso.

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: Masha tiene una hermana llamada Dasha. Un buen día, Dasha decide visitar a su hermana. Aunque se parecen mucho físicamente, ¡sus personalidades son muy diferentes! A diferencia de Masha, Dasha es una niña estricta y responsable. Masha está ansiosa por contarle al Oso las noticias y se lleva a Dasha con ella para visitarlo. Y en este momento, la historia se pone todavía más interesante...

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: Muy lejos en una casita cerca del ferrocarril vive una niña pequeña y muy inquieta llamada Masha. Le fascina tanto tocar música que los demás animales no comparten su entusiasmo, y siempre se esconden de ella. Un día, se harta de la situación y se escapa por el bosque. Allí, encuentra una casa muy acogedora donde vive el Oso, que en este momento no está porque se fue a pescar. Cuando el Oso regresa, encuentra su adorable hogar todo desordenado. Y en el interior de su casa, encuentra la fuente de este desorden: se trata de la niñita que estaba usando su cama como trampolín personal. El Oso hace lo imposible por deshacerse de la problemática invitada. Pero cuando lo consigue, comienza a sentir ansiedad al pensar en la niñita que dejó en el bosque. El Oso se apresura a buscarla y al final descubre que ella ya había regresado a su casa.

programme.title: Los Cuentos De Masha
programme.desc: Esta es una historia sobre un pequeño pero valiente niño. La moraleja de la historia es que no importa cuán grande y alto seas, no debes ofender a los pequeños. Puede suceder que te encuentres con algún pulgarcito, que vencerá a cualquier "gigante".

programme.title: Los Cuentos De Masha
programme.desc: La Zorra tenía una cabaña hecha de hielo, mientras que el Conejo, una de madera. Cuando llegó la primavera, la cabaña de la Zorra se derritió, por lo que decidió mudarse a la cabaña del Conejo y sacarlo de su propia casa. El Conejo pidió ayuda al Perro y al Lobo. Al principio estaban ansiosos por ayudarlo, pero la Zorro fue inteligente y los invitó a vivir con ella en la cabaña, para que el Conejo se quedara sin apoyo. Entonces el Conejo le pidió ayuda al Oso. Sin dudas, el Oso prefirió vivir con la Zorro en su cabaña. Pero la Zorro no lo invitó, así que irrumpió en la choza y la destruyó en pedazos. Esta historia nos enseña una verdad simple pero importante: "Trata a los demás como quisieras que te trataran a ti"

programme.title: Los Cuentos De Masha
programme.desc: Vivía un Zar con sus tres hijos. El hijo mayor se casó con la hija de un noble, el segundo se casó con la hija del comerciante, mientras que el hijo menor – con una rana. No era bonita, pero resultó ser la Princesa Rana que se convirtió en una hermosa niña. Esta historia nos enseña a cuidar a las mascotas. Esta es la única forma en que podrían apelar a sus preocupaciones y convertirse en sus amigos fieles.

programme.title: Los Cuentos De Masha
programme.desc: Una vez vivía un anciano con su esposa. Se sentían muy solos porque no tenían hijos ni nietos propios. Así, el anciano decidió hacer un ternero de paja para regalárselo a su esposa. Para evitar que se deshiciera, el hombre lo selló con resina. El ternero de paja trajo mucha alegría a los ancianos, lo que demuestra el punto de la historia, cada cosa puede ser útil y valiosa.

programme.title: Los Cuentos De Masha
programme.desc: La historia cuenta lo importante que es escuchar a los ancianos. Alyonushka y su hermano Ivanushka fueron al bosque desobedeciendo a los padres. Los niños se encontraron con la estufa mágica y el manzano parlante. La estufa alimentó a los niños con pasteles. Ivanushka tenía sed y Alyonushka fue al río de la leche con orillas de gelatina para saciar la sed de su hermano. Pero Ivanushka no esperó a que su hermana volviera y bebiera del charco. De repente se convirtió en una pequeña cabra. La bandada voladora de gansos cisne secuestró a Ivanushka, pero logró escapar. Than Ivanushka encontró a su hermana y salieron del bosque. Ivanushka ha tenido un largo proceso de curación antes de volver a su apariencia humana nuevamente.

programme.title: Las Historias Espeluznantes De Masha
programme.desc: Aquí hay otra historia espeluznante sobre inventos útiles que, sin embargo, podrían arruinar tu vida... imagínate... ¿y si hubiera un megacerebro que quisiera conquistar la Tierra con algunos monstruos mecánicos? Puedes creer que es una broma, pero hay muchos dispositivos a tu alrededor, ¿puede garantizar que estás a salvo? Bien, bien, relájate, ¡Masha encontrará una salida! ¡Oh, sí!

programme.title: Las Historias Espeluznantes De Masha
programme.desc: Masha narra una historia sobre una niña que temía a los médicos. Y una vez experimentó una historia fantástica... decidió preparar la cena para sus muñecas. Tomó un poco de arcilla e hizo “albóndigas” con “papilla de avena”. Como la comida le pareció sabrosa, Sima decidió comer un poco de su cena también… Y de repente sintió un dolor de estómago horrible. Nadie sabe cuánto tiempo necesitaría sufrir, pero cuando se despertó ... se dio cuenta de que estaba en el hospital ... cerca de la verdadera reina de las nieves ... quien explicó que el tratamiento médico no da miedo en absoluto ... ¡aunque otras cosas son muy temibles! ¡Oh, sí!

programme.title: Las Historias Espeluznantes De Masha
programme.desc: Algunas personas creen en todo tipo de presagios como gatos negros, vestidos al revés, sueños proféticos… La pobre Lucy creía tanto en ese tipo de cosas que incluso temía salir a jugar con sus amigos. ¿Y cómo podrías salir si naciste en el año del conejo púrpura que promete... pase lo que pase... Ya verás...

programme.title: Las Historias Espeluznantes De Masha
programme.desc: Crees que nadie podría tenerle miedo a una bicicleta ... Hoy, escucharás una historia increíble ... y desgarradora ... ¡sobre una bicicleta! Había un niño llamado Gosha, que se molestó cuando le regalaron una bicicleta para su cumpleaños, ya que una vez se imaginó corriendo por la calle montando ese enorme monstruo aterrador de dos ruedas. Pero en realidad es sencillo andar en bicicleta... ¿no?

programme.title: Las Historias Espeluznantes De Masha
programme.desc: ¡Una historia súper aterradora sobre un payaso extraño que de repente se enojó mucho! ¡Asustó a todos los niños y los hizo llorar! ¿Qué pasó con el payaso? Veamos este episodio súper aterrador.

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: Masha decide ayudar al Oso a conquistar a su adorada Osa. Para hacerlo, la niña arma su propia banda de rock y filma un video musical. ¡La liebre toca la batería, los lobos tocan el piano y Masha muestra su talento en la guitarra! Esto es algo que los habitantes del bosque nunca antes han visto.

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: El otoño ha llegado. El Oso arma una barrera contra Masha en la puerta de su casa para prepararse para su siesta invernal. Pero la niña se las ingenia para entrar y desata una vez más el caos cuando despierta a todo un enjambre de abejas. Pero todos sus juegos por fin llegan a su fin, y cuando el Oso cocina crema de avena para alimentarla, la encuentra dormida.

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: Por primera vez en su vida, Masha tiene miedo, ¡en serio! Esta espeluznante historia sacudió a todo el bosque y ahora casi nadie puede mantenerse alejado de estas extrañas escenas. ¿Y qué harías si tu propia almohada y manta se convirtieran en verdaderos fantasmas? Una verdadera historia de fantasmas, ¡oh, sí!

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: El Oso va a pescar. Esperanzado, lanza la línea de su caña de pescar, y en cuanto el primer pez muerde la carnada, aparece Masha y transforma un agradable viaje de pesca en una pesadilla. El Oso le construye una caña de pescar a Masha para mantenerla entretenida, y de inmediato Masha pesca al pez.

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: Masha y la Liebre están jugando un partido épico de hockey. Cuando el juego está en su punto más alto, Masha sale en busca del disco que se perdió y se topa con una escoba. Esto es mucho mejor que un palo de hockey, y a Masha se le ocurre una idea. Pero resulta que la escoba puede usarse para otras cosas además de cómo palo de hockey.

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: El Oso se despierta con la llegada de la primavera. Mientras corre por el bosque, se topa con una hermosa Osa. Muy pronto, se enamora. Recoge algunas flores y chocolates y corre hacia ella, con la esperanza de invitarla a salir en una cita. Y por supuesto, Masha estropea todos sus planes. El Oso hace lo imposible por deshacerse de la niña que perturba su idilio. La Osa por fin le presta atención al Oso y exige una explicación. El Oso trata de explicar pero se enfrenta a un dilema: Masha o la Osa. El Oso no logra decidirse sin dudar y la Osa se va con otro oso.

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: ¿Qué hay dentro de objetos aparentemente simples que nos rodean? ¿Cómo funcionan los objetos que usamos todos los días? ¿Quizá funcionan con la ayuda de la magia? ¿O quizá cada objeto tiene un orden determinado? En este episodio, Masha decide averiguar cómo funcionan los objetos que la rodean. Y en compañía de un viejo amigo, esta investigación se convierte en una aventura.

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: Un día de sol, cuando todos los animales están ocupados con sus actividades diarias, Masha decide hacerle algunas demostraciones de cariño y atención a su Cerdo favorito. Como de costumbre, sus intentos tienen resultados catastróficos para todos los que la rodean. En un intento por escapar de los cuidados de Masha, todos los animales se reúnen en la casa del Oso y expresan su indignación ante la conducta de la niña. Pero el Oso rememora su propia infancia y les recuerda a todos los difícil que es ser un niño.

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: ¿Qué hace falta para convertir un viaje común y corriente en una gran travesía? Un Oso, una banda itinerante y... a Masha. Sin embargo, el destino de este grupo no es viajar juntos muy lejos.

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: Cuando estás con tus mejores amigos, ¡la aventura está a la vuelta de la esquina! Esta vez, Masha y sus fieles compañeros emprenden un viaje en busca de tesoros piratas. ¿Qué les espera a los valientes viajeros en el camino?

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: ¿Quién serás cuando crezcas? Encontrar respuesta a esta pregunta es uno de los procesos más difíciles para cada niño, y Masha no es excepción. El Oso la convence de que en cualquier situación lo más importante es seguir siendo tú mismo.

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: El Oso nunca le habría permitido a Masha quedarse sola a altas horas de la noche mirando una película de terror. Pero no logró predecir la cantidad de problemas en los que lo podría meter una niña asustada.

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: El otoño ha llegado. El Oso arma una barrera contra Masha en la puerta de su casa para prepararse para su siesta invernal. Pero la niña se las ingenia para entrar y desata una vez más el caos cuando despierta a todo un enjambre de abejas. Pero todos sus juegos por fin llegan a su fin, y cuando el Oso cocina crema de avena para alimentarla, la encuentra dormida.
